2016 Chevrolet Silverado 2500 4WD WT DBL CAB | Municibid
2016 Chevrolet 2500 4WD WT DBL CAB, 6.0liter gas engine, 6 speed auto transmission, 4 wheel drive. Factoy side steps, snow plow prep package, trailer equipment package, cloth interior. 80,873 miles, 4,717 engine hours.  Western V Plow, Backrack, LED OH Beacon, front, rear and side LED lamps. Aftermarket Remote Start/Keyless Entry.  Stone chip windshield. No known mechanical issues. Damage to paint on both front doors where vinyl decals were removed. The damaged areas has white vinyl decal overlay. See photos for detail.  Clear, clean green Municipal Title, 2 keys, one aftermarket key fob. Previously driven as a DPW adminstrative vehicle.
